DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座のお申込みですね。この申請書はご自身でご用意されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're applying for an account, correct? Did you prepare this application yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。日本語の住所などは友人に書いてもらいました。最後の署名欄も友人に頼むつもりですが、それでよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人が代筆した申請書を示し署名も頼めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. A friend wrote the address and other Japanese entries for me. I was going to ask them to sign the final signature field too. Is that okay?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the application your friend filled out and ask whether they can also sign it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この欄は、お客様ご本人が内容を確認して署名する欄です。記入のお手伝いとは分けて考えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This field is for you to check the contents and sign personally. Please distinguish that from help filling in the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私が署名するんですね。ただ、友人が書いた内容の全部をまだ理解していないので、先に説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人署名と理解し未理解の記載の説明を先に求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I have to sign. But I don't yet understand everything my friend wrote, so I'd like an explanation first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that you must sign yourself and ask first for an explanation of entries you do not understand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: もちろんです。どの部分からご説明しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Of course. Which part would you like me to explain first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「利用目的」の所です。給与用と伝えましたが、ほかの言葉も書かれていて、何を選んだか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 利用目的の選択が分からないと具体的な欄を挙げる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The “purpose of use” section. I said it was for my salary, but other words are written too, and I don't know what was selected.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the specific purpose-of-use field and say you do not understand the selections. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 給与の受取りと生活費の支払いに印が付いています。どちらも使うご予定でしたら、この内容で合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Receiving salary and paying living expenses are marked. If you plan to use both, these entries are correct.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家賃や買い物にも使うので、両方で合っています。「生活費」がその意味だと分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 給与受取と生活費支払いの説明を理解し両方とも自分の用途に合うと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll use it for rent and shopping too, so both are right. Now I understand that “living expenses” means that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you understand salary receipts and living expense payments and that both match your intended use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、ほかの記入内容も一緒に確認しましょう。ご住所はこちらで間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the other entries together too. Is this address correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、住所も部屋番号も合っています。記入内容が分かったので、ここに自分で署名します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所と部屋番号も確認し内容を理解したうえで自分で署名すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, both the address and apartment number are right. Now that I understand the entries, I'll sign here myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the address and apartment number, then say you understand the contents and will sign yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。署名した申請書と本人確認書類をお預かりして、申込みを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I'll take the signed application and identification documents and check your application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの棚で、価格が分かりにくい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is any price on this shelf unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このスポンジの値札です。補充の後で場所が変わったようで、二つの値札のどちらがこの袋の分か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 補充後の二値札と手持ち商品の対応が不明と尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This sponge's price tag. The positions seem to have changed after restocking, and I don't know which of the two tags belongs to this bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask because you cannot match the product in your hand to the two tags after restocking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品名と入り数を見てみましょう。お持ちの袋は、五個入りですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the product name and quantity. Your bag contains five, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。ただ、値札も両方五個入りで、一方に「厚手」とあります。私の袋には小さくその文字があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ入り数でも厚手表記があると追加情報を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. But both tags also say five, and one says “thick.” My bag has that word in small print.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Add that the quantity is the same but the product says “thick.” Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、品番も照合します。こちらの袋を少しお預かりしてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then I'll compare the product numbers too. May I hold this bag for a moment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。見た目の位置だけで安いほうと考えず、この袋の価格を知ってから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 品番照合を頼み位置だけで価格を決めない意向を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Rather than assume it's the cheaper one just from its position, I want to know this bag's price before deciding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the product number comparison and say you will not decide the price from position alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 品番が一致したのはこちらの値札です。隣は標準タイプで、こちらは厚手です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This tag has the matching product number. The neighboring one is the standard type; this is the thick type.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 厚手の価格が分かりました。食器用なので、標準タイプも実物を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 厚手の価格を理解し用途に合わせ標準タイプも見たいと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Now I know the thick type's price. They're for dishes, so could you also show me the standard type itself?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the thick type's price and ask to see the standard type for your intended use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが標準タイプです。両方を比べていただけます。値札も、それぞれの品番の下へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the standard type. You can compare both. I'll put the tags back beneath their respective product numbers too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 標準タイプのほうにします。五個入りでも種類が違うと分かったので、こちらの値札の価格で買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 比較して標準タイプを選び対応する値札で買うと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll choose the standard type. I understand that even five-packs can be different types, so I'll buy it at this matching tag's price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare and choose the standard type, deciding to buy at its corresponding tag price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 標準タイプはこちらですね。厚手は売場へ戻します。お選びの商品をレジへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: This is the standard type. I'll return the thick one to the shelf. Please take your selected product to the register.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鳥をご覧になっているんですね。観察場所の案内がございますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at the birds. We have information about observation locations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩いていたら鳥が見えたので、写真を撮りたくなりました。水辺まで降りる道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 散歩中の鳥を撮るため水辺へ降りる経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw birds while walking and wanted to photograph them. Is there a path down to the water?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a route down to the water to photograph birds seen while walking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 水辺へは降りず、この園路の観察台からご覧ください。今は鳥の近くに入らないようご案内しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't go down to the water; view them from the observation platform on this park path. We're asking people not to enter the area near the birds now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。観察台へ行きます。ただ、携帯では遠すぎて写らないかもしれません。近づくのではなく、そのまま見ることにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 観察台を選び携帯で撮れなくても接近しないと応じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'll go to the platform. They may be too far away for my phone to photograph, but I'll just watch rather than get closer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the observation platform and agree not to approach even if your phone cannot photograph them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 双眼鏡をご覧になりますか。案内所で貸出しの相談を承っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you like to try binoculars? You can ask at the information center about borrowing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら借りられるか聞きたいです。初めて使うので、操作も教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 双眼鏡貸出しと初心者向け操作説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'd like to ask whether I can borrow some. It's my first time, so could someone explain how to use them too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to borrow binoculars and receive beginner instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が使い方をご説明します。観察台はほかの方も使いますので、長く場所を独占なさらないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain. Other people use the platform too, so please don't occupy one spot for too long.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。友人と二人で少しずつ見ます。写真を撮るための三脚も持っていますが、通路が狭いので今日は出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人と交代して観察し狭い通路で三脚を出さないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. My friend and I will take short turns. I also brought a tripod for photography, but the path is narrow, so I won't set it up today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will take turns with your friend and will not set up a tripod on the narrow path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。貸出しの担当はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you for cooperating. The lending officer is here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に双眼鏡の使い方を聞き、観察台で友人と交代して見ます。水辺へ降りたり通路に三脚を立てたりはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 操作を聞いて観察台で交代観察し水辺と通路を妨げないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first ask how to use the binoculars, then take turns with my friend on the platform. I won't go down to the water or put a tripod on the path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to learn the controls and take turns on the platform without going to the water or obstructing the path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当へお声がけください。観察台への道も一緒にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please speak to the officer. We'll also show you the way to the platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 行き先を入力するところでお困りですか。メッセージを見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble entering your destination? Could you show me the message?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人の家へ行きます。この地図のピンを見て切符を買おうとしましたが、友人のメッセージには別の駅名があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駅名のメッセージと店舗の地図ピンが違い切符の行き先を迷うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm going to a friend's home. I was going to buy a ticket based on this map pin, but my friend's message names a different station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the message's station and the shop's map pin differ, making your ticket destination unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 地図のピンはお店の位置を指していますね。友人が指定した駅と、その店が目的地かは別に確かめたほうがよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The pin marks a shop. It would be best to check separately which station your friend specified and whether the shop is the destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人が「ここで待って」と地図を送ったんです。駅で会うのか、店まで行くのか聞かずに出てきてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 待合せが駅か店か聞いていなかったと事情を明かす。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend sent the map saying “wait here.” I left without asking whether we're meeting at the station or going to the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not ask whether the meeting is at the station or shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今、ご友人に確認できますか。ここで駅名を決めつけて購入すると、買い直しになるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you check with your friend now? If you buy based on an assumed station, you might have to buy another ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話してみます。つながらないので、「改札で会うのか、この店で会うのか」と書いて送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話がつながらず二つの候補を明示した確認メッセージを送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll try calling. There's no answer, so I'll send “Are we meeting at the ticket gate or at this shop?”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: With the call unanswered, send a confirmation message naming both possibilities. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら待ち合わせ場所がはっきりしますね。返信まで、券売機をほかのお客様にお譲りいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: That should clarify the meeting place. Until they reply, could you let other customers use the ticket machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、横で待ちます。あ、返事が来ました。店の地図は目印で、メッセージの駅の東改札で会うそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 券売機を譲り返信で東改札が待合せと分かったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I'll wait to the side. Oh, they've replied. The shop map was a landmark; we're meeting at the east ticket gate of the station in the message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Yield the ticket machine and say the reply confirmed the east ticket gate as the meeting place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では目的地はその駅ですね。駅名はこちらで間違いありませんか。地図の店を到着地にしなくてよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then that station is your destination. Is this the right station name? The shop on the map doesn't need to be your arrival point, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、その駅まで買います。友人には東改札で待ってもらい、着いてから出口の表示を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認済みの駅まで購入し到着後は東改札表示を見ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I'll buy a ticket to that station. I'll ask my friend to wait at the east ticket gate and check the exit signs after arriving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy to the confirmed station and decide to check signs for the east ticket gate on arrival. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 駅名を選び直してからお進みください。購入前に、画面の目的地がご友人の指定と一致しているかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Select the station name again before proceeding. Before purchasing, make sure the screen's destination matches your friend's instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請の受付は済みました。こちらの番号でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your application has been accepted. Please wait with this number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この紙を不動産会社へ出せばいいんですか。証明書をもらうつもりで申請したので、これがそうかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受付控えを提出用証明書と考えてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Should I give this paper to the real estate company? I applied to get a certificate, so I thought this was it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the reception slip can be treated as the certificate for submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは受付の番号控えです。証明書は、準備ができてからお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is your reception number slip. We'll give you the certificate when it's ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受付と受取りは別ですね。もう終わったと思って帰りかけました。ここで番号を呼ばれるまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付と交付の違いを理解し帰るのをやめて待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Acceptance and collection are separate, then. I nearly went home thinking it was finished. I'll wait here until my number is called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Recognize the difference between reception and issuance, and say you will stay and wait instead of leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。お呼びした際に、本人確認の書類もお手元にご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. When we call you, please have your identification documents ready too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらにあります。手数料もまだ払っていませんが、先に別の会計の列へ並んだほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人資料を示し支払いのため別の列へ行く必要があるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here they are. I haven't paid the fee yet; should I join a separate payment queue first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your identification and ask whether you need a different queue to pay. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この窓口で交付の時にご案内しますので、先に別の列へ移らなくて結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain at this counter when issuing it, so you don't need to move to another queue first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。番号の紙は証明書と間違えず持っておきます。受け取った後、名前と住所をその場で見てもいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えを持って待ち交付後に記載を見直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll keep the number slip without mistaking it for the certificate. I may check the name and address on the spot after receiving it, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait with the slip and want to recheck the entries after issuance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: もちろんです。記載にお気付きの点があれば、その場でお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Of course. If you notice anything in the entries, please tell us there and then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、ここで交付を待ちます。会計の案内を聞き、証明書の名前と住所を確かめてから提出先へ持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 交付会計記載確認を済ませてから提出先へ持参すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll wait here for issuance. I'll follow the payment instructions and check the certificate's name and address before taking it to the recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to complete issuance, payment instructions, and entry checks before taking it to the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。番号をお呼びするまで、こちらの席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait in these seats until your number is called.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の記入で、お困りの所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there any part of the medical questionnaire you need help filling in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 肩の辺りが痛いんですが、名前がうまく言えません。この体の絵に印を付けて説明してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 痛む体の部位を日本語で言えないため図で示したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have pain around my shoulder, but can't say the part's name well. Could I mark this body diagram to explain?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to indicate the painful body part on a diagram because you cannot name it in Japanese. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、痛む場所を示してください。左右も、ご自身の体のどちら側かが分かるようにお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, indicate where it hurts. Please make clear which side of your own body you mean too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の左側です。正面から見た絵だと右に見えるので、図の端に「自分の左」と書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の左と正面図の見た目の左右を区別して書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's my left side. In a front-view diagram it looks like the right, so I'd like to write “my left” at the edge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish your left from the apparent sides of the front-view diagram in writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのように書いていただけます。診察の際、ご自身でも場所を示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You may write that. Please also indicate the spot on yourself during the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここです。肩の上ではなく、少し後ろです。自分で触れた所を見せて説明するほうが分かりやすいと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 肩の上でなく少し後ろと自分の体を示して説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here. Not the top of my shoulder, but a little toward the back. I think showing where I touch on myself will be clearer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your body and explain that it is slightly behind rather than on top of the shoulder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その説明を医師へお伝えください。いつから痛むかは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell the doctor that. Do you know when it started hurting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今朝、着替えるときに気付きました。昨日から痛かったかどうかは、はっきり覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今朝気付いた状況を答え以前の発症は不明と補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I noticed this morning while changing clothes. I don't clearly remember whether it already hurt yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe noticing it this morning and add that the earlier onset is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、今朝気付いたことと、そのときの動作も書いてください。詳しい経過は診察で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then write that you noticed this morning and what movement you were making. We'll ask about the details during the examination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 図に印を付けて、自分の左で少し後ろだと書きます。今朝着替え中に気付いたことも、診察で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 図の印と本人の左後方と気付いた状況を診察で説明すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll mark the diagram and write that it's slightly to the back on my own left. I'll also explain during the examination that I noticed while changing this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to explain the diagram mark, your left rear area, and how you noticed it during the examination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記入できましたら、こちらへお出しください。説明したい点があることも、診察担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please hand it in here when finished. I'll also tell the clinician you have points you'd like to explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談のメッセージは、お手元に残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you still have the message you want to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知人からお金を払えと音声が来ました。意味を日本語で書いてきましたが、元の音声も電話に残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知人からの音声の支払要求と自分の日本語要約が残っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An acquaintance sent a voice message demanding I pay money. I wrote its meaning in Japanese, but the original recording is still on my phone too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have the acquaintance's voice demand for payment and your own Japanese summary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相手は今、近くにいますか。まず現在の状況を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the person nearby now? Let me first check the current situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここにはいません。今夜家へ行くとも言っています。ただ、私が書いた「必ず来る」は、元の言葉より強いかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相手は不在だが訪問の発言を要約で強めたかもしれないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They aren't here. They also said they'd come to my home tonight. But my wording “definitely coming” may be stronger than the original.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the person is absent but your summary may exaggerate their statement about visiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 翻訳した文章と元の音声を、分けて確認しましょう。ご自身の判断で足した表現があることも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check your translated text separately from the original voice message. Tell us about any wording you added on your own too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この「必ず」は私が足しました。音声は母語なので、通訳の方に実際の言い方を聞いてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分が足した表現を特定し母語音声を通訳で確認するよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I added this “definitely.” The recording is in my native language, so I'd like an interpreter to hear the actual wording.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the expression you added and ask an interpreter to check the native-language recording. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 言語の支援について確認します。届いた時刻と相手のアカウントが分かる画面もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check language support. Do you also have a screen showing when it arrived and the sender's account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。腹が立ってアプリを消そうとしましたが、消す前に相談に来ました。音声と画面はそのまま見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: アプリ削除を保留し時刻とアカウントを含む元記録を見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I was angry and considered deleting the app, but came for advice before doing so. I'll show the recording and screen unchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you postponed deleting the app and will show original records including time and account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのまま拝見します。今夜の安全についても伺いますので、相手が住所を知っているか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll view them as they are. We'll also discuss your safety tonight, so please tell us whether the person knows your address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所は知っています。今夜は一人で家で待たず、信頼できる友人に連絡します。相手には会う約束をしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手が住所を知ると伝え会う約束はなく友人へ連絡する方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: They know it. I won't wait at home alone tonight; I'll contact a trusted friend. I haven't agreed to meet the person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the person knows your address, you have no meeting agreement, and you plan to contact a friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 元の記録を確認しながら、安全についての相談も続けましょう。実際に危険が迫っている場合は、すぐに助けを求めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's continue discussing safety while checking the original records. If danger is actually imminent, seek help immediately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの箱は、ゆうパックでお送りになるご予定ですか。中身を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to send this box by Yu-Pack? Please tell me what's inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 服と本で、家族に送ります。本の間に、お祝いのお金を入れた小さい封筒もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ゆうパックで送る衣類と本に現金の封筒も入っていると申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Clothes and books for my family. Between the books there's also a small envelope with gift money for a celebration.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Declare that the clothes and books being sent by Yu-Pack also contain an envelope of cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ゆうパックには現金を入れられません。現金を郵送する場合は、現金書留でお送りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Cash cannot be included in Yu-Pack. If sending cash by post, please use registered cash mail.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一緒には送れないんですね。封筒を取り出して、服と本はこの箱で送りたいです。現金書留は初めてなので、準備を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現金を取り出して別送すると決め現金書留の準備を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So they can't go together. I'll remove the envelope and send the clothes and books in this box. It's my first time using registered cash mail; please explain what to prepare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to remove and send cash separately and ask how to prepare registered cash mail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの現金書留用の封筒をご覧ください。お祝いの封筒が中に入るか、まず大きさをお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please look at this registered cash envelope. First check whether your gift envelope will fit inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この小さい封筒なら入りそうです。メッセージを書いた手紙も、お金と一緒に入れられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 封筒の大きさを確認し手紙を現金と同封できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: This small envelope looks like it will fit. Can I also enclose a letter with a message along with the money?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the envelope size and ask whether a letter may be enclosed with the cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、手紙も同封できます。宛名の記入と封の仕方を、この案内に沿ってご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, a letter can be enclosed too. I'll explain addressing and sealing following this guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、手紙もそちらに入れます。箱の送り状とは別に、こちらにも同じ宛先を書けばいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手紙も移し二つの発送物にそれぞれ宛先を書くと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll put the letter there too. I should write the same recipient here separately from the box's shipping label, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Move the letter too and confirm that each of the two items needs its own destination address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。それぞれ宛先をご記入ください。料金は、箱と現金書留を別々に確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, address each item. We'll check and explain the fees for the box and registered cash mail separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。箱は服と本だけにし、お金と手紙は現金書留にします。両方の宛先を書いてから料金を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱と現金書留の内容を分け両方の宛名記入後に料金を確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. The box will contain only clothes and books; the money and letter will go by registered cash mail. I'll check the fees after addressing both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate the contents of the box and registered cash mail, then decide to check fees after addressing both. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: まず封筒のご準備をお願いします。現金はお手元に保管し、封の仕方が分からない所はお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please prepare the envelope first. Keep the cash with you and ask if any part of sealing is unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みの操作で、お困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having difficulty making a transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃を入力していたら画面を閉じてしまいました。もう一度やり直そうと思ったんですが、二回送ってしまわないか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃振込中に画面を閉じ完了不明のまま再操作すると重複する恐れがあると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I closed the screen while entering my rent payment. I considered starting again, but I'm worried I might send it twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain closing the rent transfer screen with completion unknown and the risk of duplicate payment if repeating it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 完了の表示や、受付の控えはご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you see a completion message or transaction receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 完了は見ていません。途中で電話が来て閉じました。控えもないので、終わったかどうか分からない状態です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 着信で画面を閉じ完了表示も控えも確認していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I didn't see completion. A call came in and I closed it partway through. I have no receipt either, so I don't know whether it finished.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain closing the screen for an incoming call without seeing completion or a receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 再び振り込む前に、取引の記録を担当と確認しましょう。操作したおおよその時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Before transferring again, let's check the transaction record with the officer. Do you know roughly when you did it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十分くらい前です。金額と相手の案内はこちらです。同じ金額をもう一度入れる前に、最初の取引を見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 操作時刻と金額振込先を示し最初の取引記録の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: About ten minutes ago. Here are the amount and recipient details. Before entering the same amount again, I'd like the first transaction checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the time, amount, and recipient and request a check of the first transaction record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の確認後に、記録をお調べします。こちらに本人確認書類をお出しいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll investigate after verifying your identity. Could you provide your identification here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらです。管理会社には今日振り込むと伝えています。確認が済むまで待つので、結果が分かったら教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人資料を出し支払予定を伝えて確認結果を待つと応じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here it is. I told the management company I'd pay today. I'll wait until the check is done, so please tell me when you know the result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Provide identification, explain the planned payment, and agree to wait for the result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できました。最初のお振込みは受け付けられています。この記録の金額と振込先をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've confirmed it. Your first transfer was accepted. Please check the amount and recipient in this record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: どちらも合っています。もう一度振り込む必要はないんですね。この記録を残して、管理会社にも支払いを連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付済み取引の金額と宛先を確認し再振込せず記録を残して管理会社に連絡すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both are correct. So I don't need to transfer again. I'll keep this record and tell the management company I've paid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the accepted transaction's amount and recipient, decide against repeating it, and keep the record and notify management. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、同じ振込を繰り返さないでください。こちらがお控えです。振込先への入金状況については、受取側にもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Correct, please don't repeat the same transfer. Here is your receipt. Please also check with the recipient regarding the funds' arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計後のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a question after payment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: レシートを見たら弁当が二つになっています。買ったのは一つなので、確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入一つの弁当が二つ分レシートに登録されていると申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The receipt shows two boxed lunches. I bought one, so could you check?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that one purchased boxed lunch was registered as two on the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: レシートとお買い物の袋を拝見してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see the receipt and shopping bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、ここに一つ入っています。もう一つを売場へ戻したのではなく、最初から一つだけ取ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現物を示し最初から一つのみで棚への返品ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, there's one here. I didn't return another to the shelf; I took just one from the beginning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the item and explain you took only one initially, rather than returning another to the shelf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現物と登録を確認します。お支払いは現金でしたか、カードでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the item and registration. Did you pay cash or by card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: カードです。お控えもあります。全商品を返したいわけではなく、弁当が一つ多く登録された分だけ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: カード控えを示し全品返品でなく一つ余分な登録の修正と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Card. I have the slip too. I don't want to return everything; I only want help with the one extra boxed lunch registered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the card slip and explain you want one excess registration corrected rather than returning everything. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当に、お会計の記録を確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I'll have the officer check the payment record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。ほかの商品は全部合っています。弁当の数量の欄だけ見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ほかの商品の登録は合っていると伝え弁当の数量に絞った確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. All the other products are correct. Could you look just at the boxed lunch quantity?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the other items are correct and ask for a check specifically of the boxed lunch quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が確認しました。弁当が二回登録されていました。余分な一つ分の調整をこちらでご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The officer checked. The boxed lunch was registered twice. We'll explain how to adjust the extra one here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認ありがとうございます。ほかの商品はそのまま買います。一つ分を調整した後の金額と、新しい控えを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二重登録確認後ほかの商品を残して修正後の金額と控えを見たいと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you for checking. I'll keep buying the other items. I'd like to check the adjusted amount for one lunch and the new receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After duplicate registration is confirmed, keep the other items and ask to see the corrected amount and receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容でご案内します。元のレシートとカードのお控えを担当へお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09216-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll proceed on that basis. Please give the officer the original receipt and card slip.
